## Contract review

Served-tier: `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER`
Head-sha: `09443b1e7033acfb3b66a44edc41939626e6644f`
Local-runs: none
Scope: skills/objectstack-data/evals/hooks-security-seeds-datasources.json + skills/objectstack-data/rules/datasources.md, packages/services/service-datasource/src/datasource-env-credential.ts, packages/services/service-datasource/src/datasource-connection-service.ts, packages/cli/src/utils/datasource-env-credentials-default.ts, packages/cli/src/commands/serve.ts, packages/spec/src/data/datasource.zod.ts, packages/spec/src/data/object.zod.ts, packages/spec/src/data/driver/common.zod.ts, docs/adr/0015-external-datasource-federation.md, ui/scripts/check-skill-eval-tokens.mjs

Inputs read: card #28435 (body and all four comments, the dev report 6550536351 included), PR #28485 (body, file list, net diff against `main` at the merge base 82b29fe5), the check-runs on the head. The rule file, the runtime and the spec were read on `origin/main` (2bba35a3); none of them differs from the merge base, so the fixture is judged against one text.

Diff: two files, +14/-2. `.changeset/28435-data-eval-case3-env-credential-route.md` (new) and case 3 of the fixture (`expected_output` re-worded, `must_contain` gains `OS_DATASOURCE_ENV_CREDENTIALS` and `_PASSWORD`; prompt, `files` and `must_not_contain` unchanged). The changeset is the lane seat's ACCEPT at TIER_DEFAULT; it is read here only for ②.

### ① Derived judgments

- Accept set of case 3 narrows: an answer must now name the host switch and a derived `_PASSWORD` variable in addition to the five existing tokens. Right: this is the pin triage 6546369464 asked for, and an answer that teaches only `credentialsRef` now goes red where it stayed green before.
- Model answer replaced: the `credentialsRef` route is gone from `expected_output`; `columnMap` and `schemaMode` are kept as the card's "Wanted" requires. Right.
- `must_not_contain` unchanged (`columnName:` only); cases 1, 2, 4 to 9 untouched. Right: the card names only case 3.
- No public TypeScript, Zod or runtime surface moves; the only published artefact that changes is the `@objectstack/skills` bundle content, which ships `evals/**` through `sync-catalog.mjs` (a wipe-and-copy of the whole skill directory). Right that this is a published change (hence ②), and right that it changes no behaviour.
- Governed surface: `skills/**` is a Tier H register row, so the whole PR is Tier H; the PR is a draft and the Governed Surface Queue Guard is green. Right, and consistent with the claim and the PR body.
- Token readings: eval fixtures are in the ratchet's measured-not-ratcheted population, so the +76 tokens pay no ceiling; the objectui eval-token gate's population is `skills/objectui` only, so the dev's whole-token hand check is the only teaching check this fixture gets. I re-counted on `main`: `OS_DATASOURCE_ENV_CREDENTIALS` 1 whole-token occurrence and `_PASSWORD` 1 whole-token occurrence in `skills/objectstack-data/**/*.md` (both in `rules/datasources.md`). Right.
- The old text's angle-bracketed `datasource` placeholder is gone; incidental, but the sanitizer-safe spelling is the better one.

### ② Semver level

`'@objectstack/skills': patch` — right. The fixture ships in the package, so the change is published; it alters eval text and assertions only, no API, no key, no behaviour, so patch is the level. The changeset carries the title, a Before/Now pair, `Clause-②: no` and `Metadata-protocol: none`, matching the PR body; Check Changeset is green.

Clause-②: no — right. Nothing in the diff narrows a published capability or a spec refusal; the eval now teaches the route the spec's own `CODE_DEFINED_CREDENTIAL_ROUTE` prescription already states.

### ③ Boundary flags

- Dev `open_questions` 1 — "should case 3 also refuse the old route with `must_not_contain` `credentialsRef`?" Answered: option A, keep the `must_contain` pin only, as landed. Three reasons from the tree, not from the report: (1) `rules/datasources.md` on `main` still teaches `credentialsRef` as a declared channel that wins over the variable and never falls back, so a correct answer may name it while rejecting it for a code-declared datasource; a bare-word refusal would red exactly the answer that names the rule while following it, the objectui#7370 lesson the eval-token gate header records. (2) `OS_DATASOURCE_ENV_CREDENTIALS` in `must_contain` already reds an old-route-only answer, which is what the card asked to close. (3) `must_not_contain` is shape-checked only, by design, so an entry there has no teaching oracle behind it. Not escalated; a hard refusal remains a one-token follow-up if the maintainer wants one.
- Dev flag "NOT MEASURED: `check:dual-build-cjs-loads`" — closed by CI: `Lint · repo & tooling gates` is green on the head.
- Dev flag "CI in_progress at report time" — see the gate line below.
- Dev `out_of_scope_findings` — `objects-fields-relationships.json` not read for the same drift. I read it: it contains no `credentialsRef`, so there is nothing to file and the note resolves empty.
- No other dev flag, and no ruling on the card beyond the two triage comments, both of which this diff satisfies.

### ④ Design judgment

`skills/objectstack-data/evals/hooks-security-seeds-datasources.json`, case 3, judged against the card's eval prompt ("expose the `customers` table of our Postgres reporting database as a read-only `legacy_customer` object") and what `main` teaches and does.

Every sentence of the new model answer checks out against the cited code, read, not taken from the PR body:

- "the password is read at connect from `OS_DATASOURCE_REPORTING_PASSWORD` (the name upper-cased)" — `datasourceEnvCredentialVar` derives `OS_DATASOURCE_` + name upper-cased with every character outside `[A-Z0-9]` replaced by `_` + `_PASSWORD`. The datasource name schema is `^[a-z_][a-z0-9_]*$`, so for every valid name the replacement is the identity and "upper-cased" is exact; it also matches the rule's own wording. The read happens in `connect()` (`envCredentialVarFor`, `declared-auto` trigger, code provenance, only when neither `credentialsRef` nor `connector` is declared), i.e. at connect, as stated.
- "while the host switch `OS_DATASOURCE_ENV_CREDENTIALS` is `on`" — `resolveDatasourceEnvCredentialsSwitch`: unset or empty is off, `on`/`off` only, anything else throws.
- "`os serve`/`start`/`dev` default it on" — `serve.ts` stamps `on` through `stampDatasourceEnvCredentialsDefault` before the admin plugin's `init()`; `start` and `dev` spawn `serve`; ADR-0015 §10 note says the same.
- "`schemaMode: 'external'` (the remote schema stays unaltered)" — `SchemaMode` enum and the rule table; DDL forbidden, and `external` is auto-connect condition 1, so nothing else is needed for the datasource to connect at boot.
- "no credential in the declaration" — the driver contracts refuse inline `password` and a credential embedded in the connection URL; ADR-0015 §10 records that nothing mints a `sys_secret:` handle for a code-origin datasource, which is the premise of the card.
- "`datasource: 'reporting'` and `external: { remoteName: 'customers', columnMap }`" — object schema `external.remoteName` / `columnMap`; the rule's federated-object example.
- "the write gate stays closed (no `allowWrites`, no `writable`)" — both default `false` (`datasource.external.allowWrites`, `object.external.writable`), ADR-0015's double opt-in.

Attempts to break it:

- Could a correct answer be refused? The two new pins are both in the rule file verbatim. `OS_DATASOURCE_ENV_CREDENTIALS` is whole-token safe. `_PASSWORD` is a suffix fragment: under substring grading it matches any derived name (`OS_DATASOURCE_REPORTING_PASSWORD`, `..._WAREHOUSE_PASSWORD`), which is the intent, since the prompt does not fix the datasource name. Under a whole-token oracle like the one `ui/scripts/check-skill-eval-tokens.mjs` applies to guides, `_PASSWORD` would not match inside a concrete variable name (an identifier character precedes it), so a strictly whole-token grader would red every concrete answer. No grader in this repo applies that rule to answers (the objectui gate checks guides, and its population excludes this bundle), and the published catalog already relies on fragment pins graded as substrings (`action_` in objectstack-ai, `_views`, `_sections`, `_actions` in objectstack-i18n). Noted as a limitation of the chosen pin shape; not a finding, and no whole-token-safe spelling of a derived variable exists, so the alternative would be dropping the pin, which the switch token already covers.
- Could a wrong answer pass? An answer that declares `credentialsRef` and never mentions the switch fails the new pin. An answer that names the switch but inlines a password would pass the token check; so would the old fixture, and no `must_not_contain` can pin "no inline password" without refusing the rule's own "never inline a password" sentence. Not a regression.
- Does the answer contradict the bundle anywhere? SKILL.md's datasource line points at `rules/datasources.md` for credentials; the rule and ADR-0015 §10 teach the environment route; `CODE_DEFINED_CREDENTIAL_ROUTE` in the spec states it. One voice across SKILL.md, rule, ADR, spec and now the eval.
- Omissions: the answer does not name `type: 'postgres'` or the connection config, nor the code-provenance guard; neither did the old answer, neither is in `must_contain`, and an eval model answer is a summary, not the full declaration. Acceptable.

Must-fix: none. Should-fix: none. The `_PASSWORD` note above is recorded for the next author of this fixture, not owed by this PR.

Gates on the head at the time of this record: every non-skipped check-run is green (Check Changeset, Governed Surface Queue Guard, PR-body guards, all Lint and Type Check jobs, including `Type Check · source gates`, which runs `check-skills-token-ratchet`, and `Lint · repo & tooling gates`, which runs `check:dual-build-cjs-loads`), except `Test Core (1/8)` and `Test Core (2/8)`, still in progress. The diff touches no tested package, so those two are not expected to turn on it; the landing still waits for them to complete green and for the Tier H approval.

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么：`objectstack-data` 技能的测试题第 3 题（把 Postgres 报表库的 `customers` 表接成只读对象）换了标准答案。旧答案教的是 `credentialsRef`，新答案教代码里声明的数据源该走的路：声明里不放任何凭据，连接时从 `OS_DATASOURCE_REPORTING_PASSWORD` 读密码，前提是主机开关 `OS_DATASOURCE_ENV_CREDENTIALS` 为 `on`（`os serve`/`start`/`dev` 默认就是开的）。同时把这两个词钉进必含项。
- 为什么改：PR #28432 已经让规则文件改教这条路，但测试题还在教旧写法，而且必含项没钉住它，所以旧答案也能通过。代码里声明的数据源没有任何东西会给它铸 `sys_secret:` 句柄，照旧答案写，连接会因为缺凭据而失败。
- 风险与回滚：只改测试题文本和断言，不碰任何运行时行为。随 `@objectstack/skills` 下次发版到客户手里。回滚即 revert。
- 先看：`skills/objectstack-data/evals/hooks-security-seeds-datasources.json` 第 3 题。
- 两分钟验证：`git grep -n "OS_DATASOURCE_ENV_CREDENTIALS" skills/objectstack-data/`，规则文件和测试题各一处。
- 需要你做的：改的是 `skills/**`，属于 Tier H，需要 os-zhuang（或 hotlong）批准后才能合并。契约复审 PASS 记录 6550618244，Head-sha `09443b1e`。

席位意见：契约复审 PASS，无必修项，也无建议修改项。dev 问要不要把 `credentialsRef` 也列进禁含项，复审答不加：规则文件里仍把 `credentialsRef` 当作一条已声明的通道来讲，正确答案可能会提到它；必含的开关词已经能让只教旧路的答案失败。可以批准。
